method: For each scope, sum PASS weights / all applicable weights. Coverage is (PASS + FAIL) count / all applicable criteria count. BLOCKED and NOT TESTED are not passes. Any open P0/P1 blocks approval. Functional evidence may be automated; demo requires live UI; production requires the release environment where relevant. Never average the three scopes.

criteria.expected: Login, refresh, logout and revocation preserve correct access
Create, validate, edit, cancel and reload a project without duplicates
Valid workbook imports the independently expected door count
Preview, errors, repeat import and distinct doors in the same unit are correct
Search, filters, sorting, pagination and bulk operations affect only selected doors
Create, edit, navigate and filter events with correct assigned installers and dates
Installer can find only assigned projects/doors and reopen app with saved state
Installation creates one completed work and the correct accrual, including repeats
Additional work quantity and rate create correct nonduplicated accruals
Report and resolve a door issue without falsely completing or accruing work
Offline actions survive offline restart and synchronize after reconnect
Lost response, duplicate event, concurrent changes and reassignment do not double count
Expired cursor and cold resync preserve pending work and enforce current permissions
Account switch separates local data and does not silently discard pending actions
Independent accrual/correction/reversal arithmetic agrees across reports and clients
Rate changes do not rewrite historical accrual snapshots
Project journal and every PDF page match completed work in RU/EN/HE
Test signing is repeat-safe and accepted document remains traceable after changes
One logical delivery, retry and visible failure; local inbox receives the correct PDF
Authorized external test inbox receives signed PDF using actual production provider
Company B, other installer and restricted scopes cannot read/write/export unauthorized data
Final dashboard/reports reconcile doors, accruals and document/delivery states
580 synthetic doors remain searchable/selectable with bounded render/query behavior
Main screens have readable RU/EN/HE/RTL, accessible controls and useful error/empty/retry states
Calendar and earnings date boundaries agree in Asia/Jerusalem including DST
Fresh upgrade and supported legacy upgrade preserve constraints and data
Restore a backup into a separate database and verify contents
Current architecture, integration and API contract suites pass
Current lint, types, tests and production build pass
Current tests, types, Expo config and native build pass at stated verification level
Actual HTTPS/environment/secrets/storage/image configuration validated without placeholders
Owner-signed current release passes fresh physical-device workflow acceptance
Another person can repeat UI demo from isolated clean scenario without database repairs
Existing settings/audit/sync/outbox tools show accurate state and recoverable errors
